name: x3d-physics/v1
purpose: First Loom profile for a stepped physical simulation behind an X3D scene (x3d.physics, 13 Nov 2026: PhysX 5 under X_ITE, and MuJoCo). Accepting under it means: every exported scene is grammatical and meaningful and carries no known scene or page trap; every run record carries a hash of every step that replays unchanged in every host it names; the run answers to its exact references with limits declared before the run; any excursion beyond a tolerance is a recorded waiver within the profile's cap (none, here); where page code replaced a runtime's engine the old engine is shown off with its leaks listed; and the shipped page reaches the recorded state whatever the frame rate. It says nothing about whether the model is right where no exact reference exists, about another machine, a real GPU, listening, or the feel of the thing.

gate_map.PHYSICS-GRAMMAR: grammar and meaning on every exported scene, including the pieces and the experiments
gate_map.PHYSICS-PAGE: traps and page-traps on the page code; the sim-nonportable-math rule binds the files marked // loom:sim
gate_map.PHYSICS-RUN-RECORD: physics: every run record carries a hash of every step, replayed on every host it names, with PHYS_* codes (PHYS_HASH_DRIFT names the first step that differs)
gate_map.PHYSICS-EXACT-REFERENCE: physics: at least one closed-form or scheme-exact reference per record, with limits declared before the run (PHYS_NO_REFERENCE, PHYS_LIMIT_WIDENED, PHYS_FALSE_GREEN)
gate_map.PHYSICS-WAIVER: physics: an excursion beyond a tolerance is an accepted_failure with owner, date, reason and its own numbers; the profile's coverage binds the cap (PHYS_WAIVER_INCOMPLETE, PHYS_WAIVERS_OVER_CAP)
gate_map.PHYSICS-TAKEOVER: physics: when page code replaces a runtime's engine, the old engine is shown off on every host that has it, and every leak is listed (law 41)
gate_map.PHYSICS-LOSS: physics: authored fields the engine cannot honour are reported, not dropped (law 40)
gate_map.PHYSICS-RENDER-INDEPENDENCE: behaviour: the shipped page reaches the recorded state at two very different frame rates
gate_map.PHYSICS-CROSS-MACHINE: visible_not_run: replays on a second machine were not run
gate_map.PHYSICS-LISTENING: visible_not_run: only a person can say the sound is right

limitations: Grammar and Meaning need the x3d_mcp fork checkout (set X3D_MCP); a run that used another checkout says so in its witness.
Determinism is shown on the hosts and the machine the record names. A second machine, another engine build and a real GPU are visible_not_run, not passed.

A physics record answers to exact references where the physics has them (free fall, a pendulum, restitution, an incline, CCD). Where it has none (a ragdoll, a drum, a machine of 300 bodies) the record shows self-consistency and stated tolerances, not that the model is right.
A waiver is a recorded excursion. The profile caps how many; a passing run with waivers is a pass WITH those waivers on its receipt, never a clean pass.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
